title: PowerToys Settings and Home UI unresponsive on Win10 21H2, though background modules (FancyZones/Mouse Utilities) still work
author: Rie2250704004
summary: On Windows 10 21H2, background modules continue running while tray Quick Access and Settings/Home activation produce no visible UI.
next_action: Reproduce UI activation on the reported Windows generation and inspect the supplied diagnostics before selecting a code fix.

confidence.rationale: The failing boundary is narrowed, but the exact UI activation failure requires the attached diagnostics or a live repro.

judgment.rationale: The report includes a diagnostic archive and recording and clearly separates healthy background modules from failed UI activation; the remaining discriminator is maintainer-side examination of the attached evidence and current-version reproduction.
evidence: FancyZones and Find My Mouse still work, showing that the runner and modules are not wholly stopped.
Tray Quick Access and Settings/Home do not appear.
The issue includes a PowerToys diagnostic ZIP and two recording links.
Issue 47208 is an exact duplicate closed in favor of another report.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce UI activation on the reported Windows generation and inspect the supplied diagnostics before selecting a code fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys fix may be needed, but the public report does not identify whether Settings startup, Quick Access hosting, runtime dependencies, or OS support is the failing branch.

actions.label: Reproduce Settings and Quick Access activation

reproduce.title: Compare UI activation with healthy background modules
prerequisites: Windows 10 system matching the supported test baseline
PowerToys installed with Settings and tray icon enabled
setup: Keep the supplied 0.98.1 diagnostic archive available for comparison.
steps: Start PowerToys and verify a background module hotkey works.
Left-click the tray icon and attempt to open Quick Access.
Double-click the tray icon and attempt to open Settings/Home.
Capture process exits and compare them with the supplied diagnostic archive.
reproduce.expected_result: Quick Access and Settings/Home should open while background modules continue to function.
